metric_definition.begin: systemd recorded start of the configured direct child main process (/usr/bin/python3 -I -c original controller) for the exact invocation; not parent preparation, booking, SSH, or systemd-run client submission.
distinctions: Report successful normal full span separately from failed/nonzero/forced spans.
A failed controller elapsed field is its own recorded exception point; it cannot replace process-exit endpoint.
Raw endpoint missing stays null with reason. Never estimate it from Prep+A, common environment events or maxrank loader duration.
Unit span is host control-plane elapsed, not pure model load, GPU kernel time or client TTFT.
metric_definition.end: systemd recorded main process exit, after its executed finally/cleanup/release path if that path completed; on forced kill it is the real process termination endpoint, not proof cleanup/release completed.
excludes: external parent startup/command submission and parent postprocessing
later external abort release after a killed/dead controller unless its own wait encompasses it
future/earlier attempts and shared source/build setup
includes_when_executed: ordered normal shutdown or attempted failure cleanup
metric_definition.name: controller_process_unit_entry_to_exit_span
metric_definition.source_clock_identity: Collector records Linux boot_id and monotonic clock implementation with time namespace; loader/client joins require same trusted monotonic domain. Keep actual systemd us clock endpoint plus collection-domain evidence, do not pretend systemd has actor identity or per-rank PID.

proposed_small_receipt_schema.normal_cleanup_qualified: crosschecked original controller/cleanup/guard evidence, separate from process exit
proposed_small_receipt_schema.systemd_properties: raw limited property map, no Environment/ExecStart body dumps

recommended_minimum_change.cleanup: Retained exited unit has no controller process; retain metadata for readback. Do not add stop/reset-failed/GC operations to the timed path merely to clear the unit. Preserve original guard/container teardown and release rules.
recommended_minimum_change.conversion: Parse systemd timestamps as exact integer microseconds. start_ns=start_us*1000; end_ns=end_us*1000; full_controller_process_span_ns=(end_us-start_us)*1000. Preserve original us and units; do not claim nanosecond precision from multiplication. Do not use wall-clock timestamps.
recommended_minimum_change.failure_result: Always retain actual raw code/status/result and original child failure. Nonzero exit, signal/deadline termination, bad/missing final receipt or missing endpoint stops remaining attempts per original policy. A failure span never becomes a successful full lifecycle span.
recommended_minimum_change.identity: Exact planned unique unit name + existing unused claim/run checks + run_id/source_commit/protocol/spec/command SHA bindings. Record invocation identity (InvocationID if exposed); bind initial/terminal metadata to that same invocation, reject changed nonempty identity or unit restart. Preserve raw property values and query capture time/domain.
recommended_minimum_change.launch: Run the existing systemd-run start request bounded within the same existing per-attempt and parent absolute budgets. Launch request returncode is recorded separately; it is not child success. No new unit/actor/process registry/launch wrapper.
recommended_minimum_change.location: Existing BLOCK_BODY launch/wait only, with matching actual renderer CPU tests; child controller body/roles untouched.
recommended_minimum_change.normal_result: Only actual process ExecMainCode/exited+status0 AND Result success AND original child controller-final PASS/normal cleanup/release>=60 qualify. MainPID0 or a PASS JSON alone never suffices.
recommended_minimum_change.poll: In the same existing parent attempt loop, bounded systemctl show of the one exact fresh child unit waits for terminal execution properties; no model/Ray/Store polling. Each call/sleep consumes the original7205 wrapper/parent absolute time, not extra tail time.
recommended_minimum_change.preserve_child_argv: Keep original frozen --property=RemainAfterExit=yes and all other child settings. Replace only existing parent --wait/RemainAfterExit=no argv transformation with expiry substitution. Do not combine --wait with RemainAfterExit=yes.
recommended_minimum_change.publish: Parent atomically/O_EXCL persists small native-unit-span receipt and adds its path/hash to existing ledger before evaluating the original child receipt stop gate. Capture true endpoint even for nonzero/forced exit, but eligibility stays false. No post-GC delayed lookup, no fabricated last-poll timestamp substituted for kernel/systemd endpoint.
readback_properties: RestartCount or actual supported NRestarts property (inspect once in CPU/source preparation; do not guess field compatibility)
recommended_minimum_change.terminal_predicate: Do not use MainPID==0 alone. Successful launch may precede actual start. Require nonzero positive ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic, positive ExecMainPID, ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic>=start and >0, MainPID==0 and non-activating state. A unit that fails before exec has missing endpoint/status explicitly, not zero-duration success. Rapid successful exit need not have a positive MainPID observed by the poll.
